description: Leather Up Limited is a Karachi-based manufacturer and exporter of leather goods incorporated on 2 December 1990, converted to a public limited company in May 1993 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange since September 1994. It makes leather bags, leather garments and other leather goods for export markets, and its factory and head office are in the DHA area of Karachi.
headOffice: 23/C, 15th Commercial Street, Phase-2-Ext, DHA, Karachi, Pakistan
sourceNote: Company website (leatherupltd.com: about, contact us) and the PSX Data Portal company record for LEUL, read 2026-10-17.
